what: Clicking a same-site link keeps the current screen pinned where it was being viewed, shrinking it to .75x around the screen center while it blurs (1.2s cubic-bezier(.75,0,.25,1)). The incoming page opens to fill the screen with a polygon clip that splits apart to both sides from a gap below center (45~55% width, 50% height) (1.2s, same curve)

options.scale: Scale factor the exiting screen shrinks to, default .75

note: The original uses barba sync, so leaving and opening overlap on one screen — this part really navigates the document, so the exit finishes first and then the open runs in the new document. A site that uses barba can reuse this part’s SHUT·OPEN polygons and lengths as-is in its transition hooks (word-swap-loader-developer/shared.js)

from.where: shared.js transitions — barba sync: beforeLeave pinned · leave scale .75 + opacity 0 · enter clipPath SHUT→OPEN
